answer: The curb is a deposit-gated seat queue. A seat requires locking a refundable deposit priced above its expected emission, so one alias costs more than it earns. A farm pays that deposit per fake identity, upfront, and each lock stays frozen for epochs. Nothing on the horizon reverses this: queue price tracks active seats, not claimed influence, so fabricated identities add cost and no weight. Keys that slip through forfeit at settlement, when unrevealed seats burn the deposit. An honest operator encumbers only seats it runs; an ivory attacker funds every puppet in the oasis for no return.
